question: How many unique sessions visited the /regist/input page and then the /regist/confirm page, in that order?
sql:
WITH input_visits AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(CASE WHEN path = '/regist/input' THEN stamp END) as input_time
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/input'
    GROUP BY session
),
confirm_visits AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(CASE WHEN path = '/regist/confirm' THEN stamp END) as confirm_time
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/confirm'
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.session) as unique_sessions
FROM input_visits i
JOIN confirm_visits c ON i.session = c.session
WHERE i.input_time < c.confirm_time
